App_FooterDescription: Helldivers (2015) | Tactical Translation & Quick Chat Assistant
Trans_DontTranslateStandardOutgoing_Tool: When checked (default), your own messages that do not contain '>>' are not translated.
Trans_DontTranslateIncomingInTargetLangu: Don't translate incoming in target language
When checked (default), incoming teammate messages detected to already be in your target language are not injected as translations into in-game chat.
QC_Description: Bind pre-defined tactical callouts to hotkeys. These will be immediately broadcast to teammates in in-game chat.
QC_HostWelcome_Tooltip: Automatically sends this message to in-game chat when you are hosting and a guest player joins. If multiple players join in rapid succession, a 5-second debounce window ensures only one welcome message is sent.
QC_WelcomeInput_Tooltip: Message automatically broadcast when a guest joins your hosted match (up to 300 characters)
QC_Btn_ImportMessages_Tooltip: Import Quick Chat messages from a JSON file (shortcuts and active states remain unchanged)
QC_Btn_ExportMessages_Tooltip: Export Quick Chat messages to a JSON file
Settings_SavedMessagesLimit_Tooltip: Limits persistent table chat logs on disk from 0 to 100 MB. Setting to 0 MB disables persistent chat logging to disk.
Settings_RequestTimeout_Tooltip: Maximum wait time for AI provider translation responses before timing out (1 to 15 seconds).
Settings_DiagnosticLogs_Tooltip: Enable file logging to app.log, hook.log, and injector.log in AppData for troubleshooting.
Settings_PauseResumeShortcut_Tooltip: Master shortcut to pause or resume both Translation and Quick Chat simultaneously.
Settings_ToggleTranslationShortcut_Toolt: Shortcut to toggle only chat translation on or off without affecting Quick Chat.
Settings_ToggleQuickChatShortcut_Tooltip: Shortcut to toggle only tactical Quick Chat messages on or off without affecting Translation.
Settings_QuickChatOverlayShortcut_Toolti: Shortcut to toggle the on-screen tactical callouts overlay. Note: Helldivers must be running in Borderless Fullscreen (or Windowed) mode for the overlay to appear over the game.
Settings_ToastNotifications_Tooltip: Show on-screen popups for Pause/Resume, errors, and system tray events without losing game focus.
Settings_ToastPosition_Tooltip: Click button to open the 9-point screen anchor modal and choose where toast popups appear.
Settings_Btn_ConfigureToastPosition_Tool: Configure anchor position on screen for toasts
Settings_QuickChatPosition_Tooltip: Click button to open the 9-point screen anchor modal and choose where the tactical Quick Chat overlay appears.
Settings_Btn_ConfigureQuickChatPosition_: Configure anchor position on screen for Quick Chat overlay
Settings_OverlayAndToastSize_Tooltip: Visual scale percentage for on-screen toasts and Quick Chat overlay (50% to 200%). Sliding shows a 2-second idle preview.
Settings_TargetDisplay_Tooltip: Select which monitor overlays appear on. 'Auto' dynamically follows the Helldivers game window.
Settings_TranslationProvider_Tooltip: Select the active AI translation engine. Currently Google Gemini is supported; other providers coming soon.
Settings_GeminiApiKey_Tooltip: Your Google Gemini API key. Stored encrypted on disk and never logged.
Settings_GeminiModel_Tooltip: Gemini model identifier to use for translations (e.g. gemini-flash-lite-latest).
Settings_Btn_ResetAllSettings_Tooltip: Reset all settings across Translation & Logs and Settings tabs back to their default values
About_Subtitle: Tactical In-Game Translation Assistant for Helldivers (2015)
PosSelect_HeaderSubtitle: Click an arrow or the center circle to choose where the overlay appears.
